module: Flowgraph node "Rally Loop Init" (category once_instant, tag rally). Initializes the rally loop: reloads the loop extension (unload then load), detects the mission id and folder (RallyUtil.detectMissionIdHelper), applies the date and time of the mission environment if enabled (RallyLoopTime.applyCurrentDate, and RallyLoopTime.setPlaying(false, hour) if _rallyForceStatic), enables debug logging then calls gameplay_rallyLoop.setup(missionId, missionDir). Outputs: success (flow) or failed (flow) if no mission id is detected.
notes: On failure, an error box in the log reminds to choose a rally stage in the mission editor and to open the race file.
When the graph stops, the rally loop extension is unloaded.

_executionStopped.desc: Unloads the rally loop extension if loaded.

unloadExt.desc: Unloads the rally loop extension if it is loaded.

loadExt.desc: Loads the rally loop extension if it is not loaded.

workOnce.desc: Reloads the extension, detects the mission, configures the environment and launches gameplay_rallyLoop.setup; sets success or failed to true.
